# CONSTRUCTED INPUT, NOT A CAPTURE. No EC was read to make this file; every
# byte below was written by hand. See ../README.md.
# Shape: `ecrw.py dump 0x0400 0x0060` as §3's step 0 takes it, one 16-byte row
# per line, for the a0 block's before dump. CPU_TEMP 0x043E and GPU_TEMP 0x044F
# read the first and the last value the 0x0400-0x045F capture records for them,
# and 0x0438 -- the one other address that capture moves on this page -- reads
# 0x97, its old value in the single row the capture has for it. The companion
# after dump differs at those three and nowhere else. The address is the one
# the capture recorded and the value is the one it recorded; every other byte
# here, and 0x0439 beside it, is invented. Not a prediction that a real page
# looks like this, or that a battery reads 151 mV.
0400: 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00
0410: 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00
0420: 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00
0430: 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 97 00 00 00 00 00 32 00
0440: 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 30
0450: 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00
